text:
Indeed.
Here's the recipe.
I posted it on NCT.
(No eggs in this recipe)
15 oz. canned tuna, drained
3 T mayonnaise
3 t lemon juice
1 c bread or cracker crumbs
2 T herbs
2 t Dijon mustard
¼ t garlic powder
½ t black pepper
Oil for frying
-----
Drain the tuna.
In separate bowl mix the other ingredients.
Add the tuna, mixing well.
Form into patties and fry in oil approx. 4 minutes per side.
Serve with tartar sauce.

text:
Splurged and bought 2 Aurelio's thin crust pizzas. They were still piping hot when I got home.
Pizza 1: traditional sauce & cheese with Sausage, Mushrooms & Onions
Pizza 2: alfredo sauce with garlic, spinach, chicken and cheese
It's a local chain, main restaurant is in Homewood, IL, south suburban Chicago. They have grown from a couple stores to now having a them in a half dozen states. Their tomato sauce is sweeter than most, and also applied in a greater quantity but the crust is still nicely crisp, so basically magic. Their prices are also much higher than chains like Dominos; I don't eat pizza often (lactose intolerant) but I'm always willing to pay double and get Aurillio's instead of Domino's.
